## What I changed

One file, one addition: `crates/reviewgraphen-ingest/src/rust.rs`, in `FunctionBodyVisitor::visit_block` (rust.rs:1855-1875). I added a `syn::Stmt::Item(Item::ForeignMod(_))` arm to the hoisting scan that, for each `syn::ForeignItem`, pushes the identifier of a foreign `fn` (`decl.sig.ident`) and a foreign `static` (`decl.ident`) into the block's `hoisted` name set. All other foreign-item shapes (`type`, `type_alias`, `const`, …) fall through to `_ => {}` and contribute nothing.

This makes a block-local `extern "C" { ... }`'s `fn`/`static` names shadow a same-named module-level function for a naked call in that block, through the existing `is_locally_bound` path — so `record_call` emits the `RelationUnresolved` shadowed obstruction instead of an unsound `calls` edge. Because it reuses `push_scope`/`pop_scope`, the shadow is scoped to its own block and cannot leak past it (requirement 3), and because only the *named* foreign `fn`/`static` are hoisted rather than marking the block conservatively, an `extern "C"` that declares only *other* names blocks nothing (requirement 4). Requirement 5 (no foreign module) is untouched since the new arm only fires on a present `ForeignMod`.
